record.goal_path_summary:
We discovered WHERE the biggest chunk of missing statistics lives: the network's units all swing together in one shared direction, and our engine was only carrying two-thirds of the lopsidedness (skewness) of that collective swing. We found the exact mechanism, built a tiny formula that tracks the missing third almost perfectly on held-out networks, and showed it repairs the statistics themselves beautifully.
The surprise: repairing the statistics alone didn't improve the final answer, because the correction machine's own internals have the same blind spot. The remaining task here is teaching the machine's conversion step the same trick - a pencil-and-paper derivation, not a compute problem. When that lands, this node's fix converts into score.
